paper_title: Benzo[c]thiophene–δC60 Diadduct: An Electron Acceptor for p-n Junction Organic Solar Cells Harvesting Visible to Near-IR Light

knowledge_points.content: A series of adducts based on benzo[c]thiophene and [60]fullerene (C60) were synthesized, including a monoadduct (BTCMA), a diadduct (BTCDA), and a triadduct (BTCTA).
knowledge_points.evidence: Figure S1. 1H NMR spectrum of benthio[c]thiophene-C60 monoadduct BTCMA... Figure S3. 1H NMR spectrum of benthio[c]thiophene-C60 diadduct BTCDA... Figure S5. 1H NMR spectrum of benthio[c]thiophene-C60 triadduct BTCTA.

knowledge_points.content: The benzo[c]thiophene-C60 diadduct (BTCDA) is specifically designed as an electron acceptor for organic solar cells to extend light harvesting capabilities.
knowledge_points.evidence: Title: Benzo[c]thiophene–δC60 Diadduct: An Electron Acceptor for p-n Junction Organic Solar Cells Harvesting Visible to Near-IR Light

knowledge_points.content: Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy, including both 1H and 13C NMR, is used to confirm the chemical structure and purity of the benzo[c]thiophene-C60 monoadduct, diadduct, and triadduct.
knowledge_points.evidence: Figures S1 through S6 detail the 1H and 13C NMR spectra for BTCMA, BTCDA, and BTCTA.

knowledge_points.content: Photoemission yield spectroscopy (PYS) is employed to analyze the electronic properties of BTCDA in thin-film form, typically used to determine the ionization potential or HOMO level.
knowledge_points.evidence: Figure S7. Photoemission yield spectroscopy of BTCDA in thin film.

knowledge_points.content: The benzo[c]thiophene-C60 diadduct (BTCDA) based organic solar cells are capable of harvesting light in both the visible and near-infrared (near-IR) regions.
knowledge_points.evidence: Title: ...An Electron Acceptor for p-n Junction Organic Solar Cells Harvesting Visible to Near-IR Light

knowledge_points.content: The benzo[c]thiophene-C60 diadduct is utilized in p-n junction organic solar cell architectures.
knowledge_points.evidence: Title: Benzo[c]thiophene–δC60 Diadduct: An Electron Acceptor for p-n Junction Organic Solar Cells...

knowledge_points.content: The nomenclature BTCMA, BTCDA, and BTCTA refers to the mono-, di-, and tri-adducts of benzo[c]thiophene with C60, respectively.
knowledge_points.evidence: Figure S1... monoadduct BTCMA. Figure S3... diadduct BTCDA. Figure S5... triadduct BTCTA.

knowledge_points.content: The multi-adduct approach (moving from monoadduct to diadduct) is a strategy used to tune the electronic properties and light-harvesting range of fullerene-based acceptors.
knowledge_points.evidence: Title and contents list indicating the progression from BTCMA to BTCDA as the primary acceptor for visible to near-IR harvesting.
